parameters.description: Outline only: bridges gaps between separate parts of the artwork

parameters.name: corner_radius_mm
parameters.label: Corner radius mm
parameters.description: Rounded rectangle and Hexagon only

parameters.name: edge_style
parameters.label: Edge style
parameters.description: Top edge of the plate (of the icon in Flat icon mode)

parameters.name: icon_right_file
parameters.label: Icon right file
parameters.description: Optional second image printed on top in its own color

parameters.name: clip_detail
parameters.label: Clip detail
parameters.description: Trim the detail so it never overhangs the surface below

parameters.name: magnet_spacing_mm
parameters.label: Magnet spacing mm
parameters.description: Centre distance when using two magnets

parameters.name: magnet_clearance_mm
parameters.label: Magnet clearance mm
parameters.description: Extra room around the magnet for a press fit

parameters.name: mount_style
parameters.label: Mount style
parameters.description: Keyhole is cut into the back and needs a plate of at least 4 mm

parameters.name: mount_inset_mm
parameters.label: Mount inset mm
parameters.description: Distance from the plate edge to the screw

parameters.name: stencil_bridges
parameters.label: Stencil bridges
parameters.description: Bars that hold islands (like the centre of an O) in place

parameters.name: stamp_handle
parameters.label: Stamp handle
parameters.description: The artwork is mirrored automatically so the print reads correctly

parameters.name: blade_tip_mm
parameters.label: Blade tip mm
parameters.description: Thickness at the cutting edge

parameters.name: cutter_inner_details
parameters.label: Cutter inner details
parameters.description: Adds imprint walls along the holes inside the artwork, held by bars

parameters.name: color_layer_style
parameters.label: Color layer style
parameters.description: Traced images only. Flush: all colors at one height (multi-material). Stacked: each color a step higher. Single color: use Icon color.

parameters.name: layer_step_mm
parameters.label: Layer step mm
parameters.description: Extra height per color in Stacked style

parameters.name: min_color_feature_mm
parameters.label: Min color feature mm
parameters.description: Color areas narrower than this join the main color (tiny color islands print poorly and waste purge)

parameters.name: font_name
parameters.label: Font name
parameters.description: Choose a font installed on this device in the FormForge font menu.
